name: Open-Meteo Weather API
notes: Open-source global weather API. No API key required for non-commercial use. Sub-10ms response times via GeoDNS (EU + NA servers). Sources include NOAA GFS, ECMWF IFS, DWD ICON models. Resolution 1-11km. Covers: hourly forecasts, 16-day outlooks, 80 years of historical data. Additional APIs for marine, air quality, geocoding, elevation. Global coverage (unlike NWS which is US-only). AI-friendly: simple GET requests with lat/lon, returns clean JSON arrays. Example: https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=52.52&longitude=13.405&hourly=temperature_2m
